title: Suricata - network
description: What is on the wire, from suricata eve events in the 'suricata' stream

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata"
SELECT count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'alert'

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Bytes in both directions of all finished flows

queries.query: SELECT sum((flow_bytes_toserver + flow_bytes_toclient)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow'

SELECT count(DISTINCT src_ip) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1')
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, event_type AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Traffic by direction
panels.description: lan = private to private, egress = private to public, ingress = public to private

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, CASE WHEN (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1') THEN 'lan' WHEN (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') THEN 'egress' WHEN (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1') THEN 'ingress' ELSE 'transit' END AS breakdown_1, sum((flow_bytes_toserver + flow_bytes_toclient)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, coalesce(app_proto, proto) AS breakdown_1, sum((flow_bytes_toserver + flow_bytes_toclient)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT coalesce(app_proto, proto) AS x_axis_1, sum((flow_bytes_toserver + flow_bytes_toclient)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 12
SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, sum((flow_bytes_toserver + flow_bytes_toclient)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT dest_ip AS x_axis_1, sum((flow_bytes_toserver + flow_bytes_toclient)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT concat(proto, '/', CAST(dest_port AS VARCHAR)) AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND dest_port IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, dest_ip AS x_axis_2, proto AS x_axis_3, dest_port AS x_axis_4, app_proto AS x_axis_5, sum(flow_bytes_toserver) AS y_axis_1, sum(flow_bytes_toclient) AS y_axis_2, count(*) AS y_axis_3 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3, x_axis_4, x_axis_5 ORDER BY y_axis_1 + y_axis_2 DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, dns_rrtype AS breakdown_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'dns' AND dns_type = 'request' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT dns_rcode AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'dns' AND dns_type = 'response' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

SELECT dns_rrname AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT src_ip) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'dns' AND dns_type = 'request' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'dns' AND dns_type = 'request' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: NXDOMAIN
panels.description: Lots of NXDOMAIN from one client can mean a DGA / malware or a broken config

queries.query: SELECT dns_rrname AS x_axis_1, dest_ip AS x_axis_2, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'dns' AND dns_type = 'response' AND dns_rcode = 'NXDOMAIN' GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Resolved addresses
panels.description: Use this to map IPs from the flow panels back to names

queries.query: SELECT dns_rrname AS x_axis_1, dns_answer AS x_axis_2, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'dns' AND dns_type = 'response' AND dns_answer IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT tls_sni AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT src_ip) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'tls' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT quic_sni AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT src_ip) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'quic' AND quic_sni IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT tls_version AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'tls' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

SELECT http_hostname AS x_axis_1, http_http_method AS x_axis_2, count(*) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT src_ip) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'http' GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT http_http_user_agent AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT src_ip) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'http' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, dest_ip AS x_axis_2, ssh_client_software_version AS x_axis_3, ssh_server_software_version AS x_axis_4, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'ssh' GROUP BY x_axis_1, x_axis_2, x_axis_3, x_axis_4 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, src_ip AS breakdown_1, sum((flow_bytes_toserver + flow_bytes_toclient)) AS y_axis_1 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND NOT (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1') GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

SELECT dhcp_client_mac AS x_axis_1, max(dhcp_hostname) AS x_axis_2, max(dhcp_assigned_ip) AS x_axis_3, max(to_timestamp_micros(_timestamp)) AS y_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_2 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'dhcp' AND dhcp_client_mac IS NOT NULL GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT src_ip AS x_axis_1, count(DISTINCT dest_ip) AS y_axis_1, count(DISTINCT dest_port) AS y_axis_2, sum(flow_bytes_toserver) AS y_axis_3 FROM "suricata" WHERE event_type = 'flow' AND (src_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR src_ip LIKE '10.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR src_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR src_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR src_ip LIKE '127.%' OR src_ip = '::1') AND NOT (dest_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.16.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.17.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.18.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.19.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.2_.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.30.%' OR dest_ip LIKE '172.31.%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fe80:%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fd%' OR dest_ip LIKE 'fc%' OR dest_ip LIKE '127.%' OR dest_ip = '::1') GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 100
